messages.subject: Difference between local app and server app with respect to href-tag
parts:
Dear all,
 
I am struggeling with an unexpected behavior....
 
Using in ui.R the code:
 
HTML('<a href="./files/W2219.ppt" target="_blank"> TEST 2219</a>'),
 
leads on the local app to a link in the browser like 
  • localhost:8100/files/W2219.ppt (which is fine as the browser can open the file) and
on the server to a link like
  • servername/Experimental/Post_Mortem/files/W2219.ppt 
On the server the file is not found ("File not found" error) despite the fact that it is in the directory /srv/shiny_server/Experimental/Post_Mortem/www/files.
 
By the way, exchanging in the HTML statement " by ' and ' by " does not change the situation.
 
Has anybody a hint for me?
 
Thank you & best regards,
 
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: Difference between local app and server app with respect to href-tag
parts:
There's not, weirdly, a <base href> tag in your HTML, is there? That's the only thing I could think of to cause this bizarre behavior.

The other thing to watch out for in these situations (though apparently not the problem for you) is that the URL must match the filename case sensitively, unlike on Windows.

Hi all,

I installed the version 1.1.0.1000 of shiny server with version 0.9.1 of shiny and the problem is not resolved

$ link1 output <- renderText ({
lin < -c ("1" = " ORSA 2013 ", "2 " = " ALM DashBoard ", "3 " = " KRI DashBoard " )
y < - data.frame ( "Key" = names (flax ) , "Value" = lin)
names ( y) < -c ( " Nr ", " Document")

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Difference between local app and server app with respect to href-tag
parts:
Alain, the problem is that the file should be located here:

/home/poncelet/ShinyApps/KRI_DashBoard/www/BI_KRI_DASHBOARD.pdf

to be available at that URL. The "www" is what tells Shiny that files on disk are allowed to be served to browsers, otherwise e.g. your data files would be open to download, which may not be what you want.
